governing_semantics.use_note: Governance/type system only; no R046/R047C target-specific content consumed.

basis.name: COMPOSITIONAL_REFINEMENT_INTERFACE
basis.weakest_legal_statement: A candidate that claims extensivity, enlargement, partition, aggregation, or scale must exhibit a finite typed partial composition ⊙ of native presentations (or an equivalent interface-gluing category) that is associative up to N0-isomorphism on compatible triples, together with any claimed refinement/coarsening maps ρ that satisfy identity and composition laws. No scalar length/area/measure is part of NB-A.

theorem_critical_symbols.I: N0-declared or N0-definable typed interface/port object when gluing is claimed
theorem_critical_symbols.⊙_φ: partial composition along an admissible interface isomorphism φ
theorem_critical_symbols.ρ_β←α: claimed refinement/coarsening map between finite presentation levels
theorem_critical_symbols.≅_N0: isomorphism preserving only declared N0 relations/state predicates

typed_dependency_graph: compatible finite presentations + interface witness φ -> S1 ⊙_φ S2
NB-A does NOT depend on N2 scalarization or N3 geometry
basis.not_output_copying: The obligation is generic finite relational composability/coherence. It withholds center, distance, radius, angle, continuum measure and engineering units; an extensive scalar, if later used, must be an N2 homomorphism or quotient derived from this structure rather than part of NB-A.

independence_witnesses.witness: Finite typed records with associative disjoint/interface union and identity refinement maps, but with no chosen update relation, satisfy NB-A while providing no N1 recurrence/relaxation dynamics.
A symmetric compositional presentation may admit only the trivial automorphism-invariant scalar quotient; composition alone does not supply a nontrivial comparison/readout.

basis.name: CONSERVATIVE_RELAXING_FINITE_ACTION
basis.weakest_legal_statement: A candidate that claims conservation plus genuine relaxation/recurrence must provide a finite-information local update relation U closed on its declared state family and equivariant under relevant N0 relabelings, together with (i) at least one nonconstant internally derived finite carrier C invariant under every legal U-step, and (ii) at least one nonconstant well-founded internally derived quotient/potential P for which a nonempty class of legal trajectories strictly descends before entering a terminal or recurrent class. Neither universal convergence nor a metric contraction is required.

theorem_critical_symbols.U: finite local update relation or generated transformation semigroup
theorem_critical_symbols.C: N0/N1-derived finite invariant carrier; N2 when scalarized
theorem_critical_symbols.P: N0/N1-derived finite well-founded quotient/potential; N2 readout
theorem_critical_symbols.R(U): terminal/recurrent strongly connected classes of the finite transition graph

typed_dependency_graph: N0 carrier/relations -> admissible local update schema U (N1)
U -> finite transition graph / generated semigroup (N1)
N0+U -> invariant carrier C and well-founded quotient P (N2 when read out)
basis.not_output_copying: C and P must be built from finite state/update data and relabeling-invariant constructions. They are not named measure, energy, clock, distance, diffusion, resonance, or any engineering observable; external interpretation is withheld.

independence_witnesses.witness: A three-state transition system 2→1→0, 0→0 has closed relaxation dynamics but no nontrivial declared partition/gluing/refinement algebra, so NB-B-type operation can exist without NB-A.

A transitive finite permutation action has exact recurrence and conserved orbit membership but no nonconstant automorphism-invariant total ordering of states; action structure does not force an ordered readout.

independence_witnesses.internal_split_test: Conservation and relaxation are logically independent: a finite permutation preserves all orbit invariants but has no strict well-founded descent; a constant map relaxes but need not preserve any nonconstant carrier. NB-B is therefore a coexistence capability, not an assertion that either property derives from the other.

basis.name: FUNCTORIAL_FINITE_QUOTIENT_COMPARISON
basis.weakest_legal_statement: Whenever a candidate claims fractions, rates, ordered/separated response, or an extensive observable, it must derive a finite quotient q:S→Q from N0/N1 data only, prove relabeling/choice invariance at the claimed strength, and show that the relevant composition and/or update descends to Q. Any comparison ≼ on Q must itself be internally generated (for example by reachability, inclusion, divisibility, finite-fiber cardinality, or a proved monotone), not copied from external units. Rational fractions may be ratios of finite event/fiber counts; conversion to engineering units is explicitly excluded and belongs to calibration.

theorem_critical_symbols.q: finite N2 quotient/readout derived from N0/N1
theorem_critical_symbols.≼: internally generated preorder/partial order on Q when claimed
theorem_critical_symbols.n(A)/n(B): optional exact rational ratio of finite internally defined counts
theorem_critical_symbols.Ū: induced action on Q when q∘U=Ū∘q
theorem_critical_symbols.⊙̄: induced composition on Q when q respects NB-A composition

typed_dependency_graph: N0 and optional N1 action -> definable equivalence/readout q:S→Q (N2)
q + U compatibility -> induced quotient action Ū
q + composition compatibility -> induced quotient composition ⊙̄
Q structure -> internally generated comparison/fraction claims
basis.not_output_copying: NB-C only requires an internal finite quotient/comparison. It forbids naming target-side geometry, waveform, unit, constant, or metrology convention as q. External traceability is not part of this debt.
dependencies: NB-B when rate/response under update is claimed

independence_witnesses.witness: A finite directed chain 0→1→2 has an intrinsic reachability order and quotient-by-mutual-reachability, but no declared gluing/refinement operation.
A static finite relational object can have a nontrivial automorphism-invariant quotient such as degree classes without any chosen update operation.

compression_summary.key_result: D1-D4 factor through three typed capabilities: compositional/refinement structure (NB-A), a finite conservative-relaxing action (NB-B), and a functorial finite quotient/comparison (NB-C). D5 is calibration/metrology; D6 is evaluation/explanatory-compression.

freeze_rule: This object is frozen before any G2 candidate definition is admitted. Later candidate generation may depend on NB-A/B/C but may not mutate them in-place.
